# Onboarding wizard — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the onboarding wizard when setup walks through steps: steps inline or in a modal with canonical step state. `steps` are data — id, title, description, content — over the canonical value trio, and `variant` page renders the inline flow while `modal` wraps the same strip with panel and footer in the overlay: one scaffold, never two, with the modal adding the open trio and `onClose`. Step bodies ride the tab items' content, so every tab keeps a resolving panel target and no second panel sits beside the strip. Back, continue, finish and cancel labels are props, and the step actions are the allowlisted intents — the wizard reports and the host routes — while the step region reports progress politely as steps change. There is no product logic inside: the service step preset composes the picker over the injected catalog and the wizard never holds domain state.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the onboarding wizard when setup walks through steps: steps inline or in a modal with canonical step state — the native twin under the same contract. `steps` are data — id, title, description, content — over the canonical value trio, and `variant` page renders the inline flow while `modal` wraps the same strip with panel and footer in the overlay: one scaffold, never two, with the modal adding the open trio and `onClose`. Step bodies ride the tab items' content, so every tab keeps a resolving panel target and no second panel sits beside the strip. Steps keep the tab press model with screen-reader tab roles, the accessible label names the wizard, and the footer actions are the allowlisted step intents — the wizard reports and the host routes. There is no product logic inside: the service step preset composes the picker over the injected catalog and the wizard never holds domain state.
